result.scope: Development test of executable policy generation, not a claim that program generation itself is novel, nor an ICLR-scale evaluation.

assessment.headline_cn: 源经验生成的策略在 8 个新几何任务上全通过；同一动作先验加普通 GP 也为 8/8，尚未建立独特的新机制。

source_acquisition.source_gp_uses: All unique actions from all source records; source-only likelihood calibration.

assessment.interpretation: There is a useful executable source-experience transfer signal in this development sample. The unchanged generated policy wins all eight targets and uses 37 queries. However, seven already succeed without history, removing contact-event labels changes no proposal or trajectory, and ordinary GP with the identical source-derived proposal prior also wins all eight in 45 queries. These observations do not establish a distinct new experimental learning mechanism.
assessment.causal_boundary: The no-outcome mask retains attempted actions, invalid flags and attempt count; the prior-only arm supplies empty history, so it also removes the attempt schedule. Their 6/8 versus 7/8 difference must not be interpreted as an isolated score-feedback effect. Ablations and prior-matched controls were specified after observing the original results and reuse the same eight development targets.
assessment.mechanism: Source-authored code contains geometry-relative large-ball proposals, score-thresholded local Gaussian perturbations, approximate collision rejection and a parcel contact branch. The branch is unnecessary on observed targets. This is an implemented program, not a new estimator established by naming it.
limitations: Two native families and four target seeds each; one optimizer seed and one authored program per condition.
World laws remain fixed; new scene geometry is not changed-law transfer.
No faithful HExA or Causal-PIK reproduction and no ICLR-scale evaluation.
The no-experience program has 74 invalid proposals; both programs conservatively treat the randomly initialized red placeholder as an obstacle. Outputs were evaluated unchanged.
Model prompting and source-summary selection are part of the method; no causal isolation of all summary or prompt choices.
37 versus 45 queries is a small development difference, not established statistical superiority.

native_replay.scope: Replay of all eight generated-policy successes through native env.step; verification only, not eight additional independent tasks.

native_verification.scope: Replay of all eight generated-policy successes through native env.step; verification only, not eight additional independent tasks.

assessment.decision: Retain the source-prior capability and all successful records; do not claim novel event-feedback learning or scale up yet.
assessment.next_requirement: Keep the demonstrated source-derived geometry prior as a working baseline. A new method must identify and test a learning operation beyond ordinary experience-to-code generation plus prior-guided continuous optimization; isolate its causal contribution against the identical prior with ordinary optimizers and applicable HExA/Causal-PIK methods. The current two task families vary geometry, not world laws. Independent seeds/model generations and changed-mechanism/core-task evidence are required before broad novelty claims or long GPU work.

headline_cn: 源经验生成的策略在 8 个新几何任务上全通过；同一动作先验加普通 GP 也为 8/8，尚未建立独特的新机制。
report_note_cn: 本轮首次实际生成并执行实验策略：deepseek-v4-pro 分别读取 8 个源场景的 106 条精选观测或仅任务说明，各生成一个未修改的程序。源记录共 565 次已完成查询，未新增采集。两类任务各 4 个此前未用于生成的种子，每任务最多 25 次尝试。有经验程序成功 8/8、共 37 次尝试，无经验程序 0/8、200 次；读取全部源数据的几何条件 GP 为 3/8、171 次，目标任务 GP 为 2/8、196 次。成功动作均通过原生 env.step 重放，结果和步数一致。同一批任务上的事后消融显示：屏蔽接触事件标签仍为 8/8、37 次且轨迹完全一致；完全无历史为 7/8、59 次；保留尝试次数但屏蔽结果反馈为 6/8、70 次。将同一个源程序的无历史动作先验交给普通优化器后，GP 也达到 8/8、45 次，CMA-ES 为 6/8、71 次。因此收益主要支持源经验构造了有效的几何动作先验，尚不能归因于新的实验反馈机制；37 对 45 次的差异仍是单一策略、单一随机种子的开发结果。这里只改变场景几何，没有测试物理规律改变、跨任务族迁移，也没有复现完整 HExA/Causal-PIK。本轮合计 894 次查询、746 条有效轨迹（含 8 次验证重放）、3 次成功模型请求，未使用 GPU。备用配置复核和两次程序生成均成功，主接口本轮未重测。
